reporting-org.narrative: Foundation for Ageing and Inclusive Development

title.narrative: SCORE - (Strengthening Civil Society for Older People's Rights and Engagement)

description.narrative: The SCORE (Strengthening Civil Society for Older People’s Rights and Engagement) programme aims to strengthen the capacity, influence, and sustainability of civil society organizations working on ageing and the rights of older people. The programme supports partner organizations to enhance their institutional systems, promote age-, gender-, and disability-inclusive approaches, generate evidence, and engage in policy dialogue and advocacy. Through capacity strengthening, research, participatory grant mechanisms, and partnerships with older people’s groups, SCORE seeks to amplify the voices of older people and promote their meaningful participation in shaping policies and services that affect their lives.

participating-org.narrative: Foundation for Ageing and Inclusive Development - FAID

recipient-country.narrative: The project is implementing in 9 countries by HelpAge International. Here we are publishing data only for Pakistan, one of the project country.

sector.narrative: The project contributes to healthy ageing and the promotion of wellbeing for people of all ages by strengthening civil society organizations and empowering older people to advocate for their rights, access to health services, and inclusive policies. Through capacity building, evidence generation, and policy engagement, the initiative promotes age-inclusive health systems, universal health coverage, and social protection measures that support the health, dignity, and wellbeing of older people and their communities.
